profile.headline: Software Engineer | Apache Spark | Python | SQL | Scala
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Experienced and results-driven Software Engineer with a relentless focus on building and optimizing cutting-edge data platforms and pipelines. Currently, I am playing a pivotal role in driving the success of Coupa Software as a Software Engineer on the Data Platform team. With an impressive track record of revolutionizing data processing, I have spearheaded the development of highly scalable ETL processes and crafted robust data visualization dashboards, empowering data-driven decision-making that propels organizational growth.

In my previous role at Tata Consultancy Services, I led the charge in crafting scalable ETL processes using Apache Spark and Scala on AWS EMR clusters, efficiently handling vast volumes of OTT and CTV Ads data. Additionally, I played an instrumental role in architecting real-time data pipelines to process Digital Ads Campaign data, seamlessly integrating millions of records through SQL and Google BigQuery on the GCP platform. These groundbreaking achievements significantly amplified data processing efficiency, catalyzing invaluable insights that fuel the organization's success.

My fervent passion for optimization extends to flawlessly streamlining daily ETL processes, adeptly managing data extraction from thousands of instances, and expertly storing it in centralized storage. Beyond my technical prowess, I am also deeply committed to mentoring and imparting Big Data technologies to students, further amplifying my expertise.

I thrive on conquering intricate challenges and orchestrating seamless collaborations with cross-functional teams to drive transformational data solutions. As an innovative visionary, I am relentless in staying at the forefront of technology advancements, unleashing the full potential of data for unprecedented growth and success.

Let's connect and explore boundless opportunities for collaboration, where my unwavering skills can be a driving force in propelling your organization to unparalleled heights of achievement.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Data Platform
positions.description:
• Led transition of app from proof-of-concept to production, delivering team's first microservice, including API endpoints, integration of internal frameworks, deployment on AWS ECS
• Revolutionized data processing with an incremental pipeline, leveraging Apache Spark, Apache Hudi, and Python, leading to an extraordinary 80 percent performance boost. Successfully incorporated this pipeline for organization-wide annual benchmarking, elevating data-driven decision-making to new heights.
• Streamlined and optimized the daily ETL process, extracting data from thousands of instances and efficiently storing it in centralized storage. Pioneered the design of comprehensive big data platforms encompassing data acquisition (ETL, ELT), processing (Spark, Snowflake), orchestration, data APIs, and innovative applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Data pipeline
positions.description:
• Client: Nielsen
•  Build scalable ETL process using Apache Spark and Scala on AWS EMR clusters for OTT and CTV Ads data and orchestrating using DAGs with Apache Airflow.
•  Design the real-time data pipeline to process Digital Ads Campaign data by integrating 100 million records using SQL and Google BigQuery on the GCP platform.
•  Develop Unit Test Cases using the JUnit framework for various Data Quantity checks using Scala.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Big Data
positions.description:
• Implemented Data pipeline between MongoDB and SQL Server​, performing ETL using Apache Spark, Python, and Scala.
• Improved Data preprocessing and validation time by 70% with MongoDB Connector for Apache Spark using Spark SQL and RDD.
• Designed internal process improvements: automated manual processes, optimized data delivery, re-designed infrastructure improving scalability.

positions.title: Big Data Engineer, Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Course: CS643-Cloud Computing.
• Organized lectures on Big Data and its application using Cloud Technologies - AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure.
• Mentored 7 teams of students in building projects using Hadoop, MapReduce, Java, and JavaScript improving students’ skill sets in Big Data.
• Administered 25 students with grading of assignments and reorganizing the course materials.

positions.title: Data Scientist (Capstone Project)
positions.description:
• Extracted Top-5 Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) from data having 117 free-text field features using Python, NLP, and RegEx, ranked at the top 5% of the capstone program performance metrics.
• Launched Dashboard for specific Keyword searches using PowerBI customizing data visualization.
• Modeled Machine Learning Algorithm to find missing data in various feature columns using sklearn, TfidfTransformer, and TfidfVectorizer gained accuracy of 76%.

educations.schoolName: LDRP Institute of Technology & Research, Gujarat Technological University

certifications.title: RESTful API with HTTP and JavaScript

volunteerExperiences.description:

• Preparing and sharing notes of their respective classes.

projects.title: ASHRAE - Great Energy Predictor
projects.description: Designed Machine Learning model to predict future energy usage of buildings using LightGBM classifier resulting in 85.4 % accuracy. Conducted Exploratory Data Analysis using Python, Matplotlib, and Seaborn libraries.

projects.title: Astute Bell
projects.description:
• Created a working prototype of IoT based automated security system for detecting a person with passive infrared sensors recognizing face using the Pi camera module and the OpenCV libraries and unlocking an electric lock on recognition of face which are registered in the database.
• Developed web API for accessing the system using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap and developed a server for hosting the web interface on Flask framework in Raspberry Pi 3.
• Worked with multiple aspects of the software prototype together and integrated them together to develop fully functional software.
